8252.title: Startup plugin gate can open before timeline readiness
8252.rootCauseOneLine: Non-priority imports wait on critical module completion or a three-second page-age deadline, neither of which observes timeline readiness.
8252.proposedFix: Decide a plugin-specific timeline readiness and priority policy, including empty/error paths and a deadline, then validate cold/warm startup and post-row responsiveness before changing scheduling.
8252.caveats: Two clean scheduling-boundary reproductions; importer is observed at an existing injected boundary. No actual plugin bundle evaluation, phone benchmark, third-party installation, or prototype comparison. No safe simple fix without a product-policy decision.
